driver-gloves-lunar-weave.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Lunar Weave
driver-gloves-lunar-weave.desc:
These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. Midnight blue suede has been interwoven with jet black leather to give these gloves a timeless look.

Keeps the blood off your hands...metaphorically speaking

specialist-gloves-big-swell.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Big Swell
specialist-gloves-big-swell.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

ak-47-wild-lotus.name: AK-47 | Wild Lotus
ak-47-wild-lotus.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom paint job of an orange lotus has been hand painted over a green base.

Muck or nettles

ak-47-crossfade.name: AK-47 | Crossfade
ak-47-crossfade.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a multicolored graphic design.

Caught between frames

ak-47-jaguar.name: AK-47 | Jaguar
ak-47-jaguar.desc: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with the image of a panther over a tiger camo background.

ak-47-gold-arabesque.name: AK-47 | Gold Arabesque
ak-47-gold-arabesque.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. An intricate design has been hand painted on the stock and handguard. The metal has been painted gold with filigree accents.

"What other tricks does Booth have up his sleeve?"

aug-ricochet.name: AUG | Ricochet
aug-ricochet.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted with a two tone knotwork pattern.

Kotaro doesn't need our protection - The Valkyrie and The Paramour Part 2

aug-arctic-wolf.name: AUG | Arctic Wolf
aug-arctic-wolf.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A custom paint job has been applied which resembles the white coat of an arctic wolf.

Every round is a 1v5

awp-ice-coaled.name: AWP | Ice Coaled
awp-ice-coaled.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a vibrant green and blue gradient.

Cold to the touch

awp-fever-dream.name: AWP | Fever Dream
awp-fever-dream.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with pink, blue, and purple drawings atop a black base.

Delirium is a dangerous thing

bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bayonet-stained.name: ★ Bayonet | Stained
bayonet-stained.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

pp-bizon-cobalt-halftone.name: PP-Bizon | Cobalt Halftone
pp-bizon-cobalt-halftone.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a hydrographic in an oversized halftone pattern over a base coat of turquoise metallic paint.

Felix, you and I both know Valeria's about to wage a war.  The only question is are you prepared? - Booth, Arms Dealer

pp-bizon-osiris.name: PP-Bizon | Osiris
pp-bizon-osiris.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in black, white, and amber.

cz75-auto-red-astor.name: CZ75-Auto | Red Astor
cz75-auto-red-astor.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been hand painted with red and white accents.

Booth has become synonymous with family drama; and who has time for drama when we're talking business - Huxley, The Competition

desert-eagle-emerald-jormungandr.name: Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr
desert-eagle-emerald-jormungandr.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A green pattern depicting Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, has been applied.

Wake the gods

desert-eagle-firebreathing.name: Desert Eagle | Firebreathing
desert-eagle-firebreathing.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with purple and blue flames using pearlescent paint.

Contains exceptional qualities and abilities

dual-berettas-oil-change.name: Dual Berettas | Oil Change
dual-berettas-oil-change.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been spray-painted with a pattern of engine components.

"It doesn't look good..."

famas-doomkitty.name: FAMAS | Doomkitty
famas-doomkitty.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been hydro-dipped with a graphic of overlapping cat skulls.

famas-byproduct.name: FAMAS | Byproduct
famas-byproduct.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A gold-colored burst pattern has been applied.

"Cool guys don't look at explosions"

famas-teardown.name: FAMAS | Teardown
famas-teardown.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

five-seven-boost-protocol.name: Five-SeveN | Boost Protocol
five-seven-boost-protocol.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted using high contrast colors. The robot icon beneath the rear sight matches the art on the slide.

Callsign: MECHA 0272

five-seven-forest-night.name: Five-SeveN | Forest Night
five-seven-forest-night.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

five-seven-hot-shot.name: Five-SeveN | Hot Shot
five-seven-hot-shot.desc: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted solid colors in light grey and hot green.

galil-ar-control.name: Galil AR | Control
galil-ar-control.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted using grey, yellow, and red and takes inspiration from racing liveries.

Now available with all-wheel drive

galil-ar-winter-forest.name: Galil AR | Winter Forest
galil-ar-winter-forest.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

galil-ar-acid-dart.name: Galil AR | Acid Dart
galil-ar-acid-dart.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A green and yellow hydrographic pattern has been applied

Let it rip

galil-ar-caution.name: Galil AR | CAUTION!
galil-ar-caution.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been spray painted with high contrast black and yellow chevrons.

Take comfort in feeling uncomfortable

galil-ar-hunting-blind.name: Galil AR | Hunting Blind
galil-ar-hunting-blind.desc: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

p2000-granite-marbleized.name: P2000 | Granite Marbleized
p2000-granite-marbleized.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.

butterfly-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

butterfly-knife-black-laminate.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Black Laminate
butterfly-knife-black-laminate.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

survival-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Survival Knife | Tiger Tooth
survival-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

paracord-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Case Hardened
paracord-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

classic-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Classic Knife | Case Hardened
classic-knife-case-hardened.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

falchion-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

navaja-knife-scorched.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Scorched
navaja-knife-scorched.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

karambit-freehand.name: ★ Karambit | Freehand
karambit-freehand.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

kukri-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Night Stripe
kukri-knife-night-stripe.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

m9-bayonet-slaughter.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Slaughter
m9-bayonet-slaughter.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

nomad-knife-scorched.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Scorched
nomad-knife-scorched.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler
shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-stained.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Stained
shadow-daggers-stained.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

skeleton-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Slaughter
skeleton-knife-slaughter.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Night Stripe
stiletto-knife-night-stripe.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

huntsman-knife-lore.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Lore
huntsman-knife-lore.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

m249-submerged.name: M249 | Submerged
m249-submerged.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted using teal-colored desert camouflage and environments as inspiration.

"WE'VE BEEN SET UP! THEY'RE EVERYWHERE!"

m4a4-mainframe.name: M4A4 | Mainframe
m4a4-mainframe.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A black and white circuit board pattern has been applied.

At the heart of it all

m4a4-desert-strike.name: M4A4 | Desert-Strike
m4a4-desert-strike.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in tan and black.

m4a1-s-party-animal.name: M4A1-S | Party Animal
m4a1-s-party-animal.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A bright, neon-colored animal print pattern has been applied.

You said "a few colors", not "the entire color spectrum"

mac-10-derailment.name: MAC-10 | Derailment
mac-10-derailment.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with an exploding train car.

"Your attention please..."

mag-7-copper-oxide.name: MAG-7 | Copper Oxide
mag-7-copper-oxide.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted with blue and rose gold solid colors.

I'm trying something different here, tell me what you think - Yukako, Gunsmith

mag-7-sand-dune.name: MAG-7 | Sand Dune
mag-7-sand-dune.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.

With Turner dead, we have a new priority: rescue Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

mp9-pandoras-box.name: MP9 | Pandora's Box
mp9-pandoras-box.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been airbrushed with cartoon spirits.

 The world is in flames, but at least we have hope

mp9-bee-tron.name: MP9 | Bee-Tron
mp9-bee-tron.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. Primarily silver, the grooves of this MP9 have been filled with yellow and red paint.

Hold me back!

negev-terrain.name: Negev | Terrain
negev-terrain.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted using a hydrographic with a terrain motif.

For someone who is supposed to be impartial, your daughter made an interesting choice for companionship - The Father and The Phoenix Part 1

nova-graphite.name: Nova | Graphite
nova-graphite.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted in a polygon pattern with metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

nova-baroque-orange.name: Nova | Baroque Orange
nova-baroque-orange.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. An intricate, Italian inspired red and gold pattern has been applied.

Last Supper is served

nova-hyper-beast.name: Nova | Hyper Beast
nova-hyper-beast.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted with a beastly creature in psychedelic colors.

They call you The Oni, right? Such a scary name for such a sad man... – Elliot Kingsman, Mercenary

nova-marsh-grass.name: Nova | Marsh Grass
nova-marsh-grass.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A grass marsh pattern has been applied.

That's one way to "touch grass"

p250-red-rock.name: P250 | Red Rock
p250-red-rock.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A custom DDPAT camouflage with yellows and oranges has been applied.

Just over the horizon

p250-mehndi.name: P250 | Mehndi
p250-mehndi.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a paisley pattern.

Namaste

p250-whiteout.name: P250 | Whiteout
p250-whiteout.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It is spray-painted all white.

It looks pure, but looks can be deceiving

p90-virus.name: P90 | Virus
p90-virus.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted using a zombie hydrographic over a green base coat.

p90-storm.name: P90 | Storm
p90-storm.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.

It will be waiting for you at the monorail

r8-revolver-fade.name: R8 Revolver | Fade
r8-revolver-fade.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

sawed-off-morris.name: Sawed-Off | Morris
sawed-off-morris.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been hand painted with ornate flowers using a pale color palette.

Close quarters nouveau

scar-20-magna-carta.name: SCAR-20 | Magna Carta
scar-20-magna-carta.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A purple-colored pattern of crests, scrawls, and text from the Magna Carta has been applied.

Everyone is subject to due process—even you

ssg-08-mainframe-001.name: SSG 08 | Mainframe 001
ssg-08-mainframe-001.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A high tech custom paint job of blues and purples has been applied.

What secrets does _001 hold?

tec-9-terrace.name: Tec-9 | Terrace
tec-9-terrace.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a geometric motif.

You're too trusting Valeria... it will get you killed - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

ump-45-moonrise.name: UMP-45 | Moonrise
ump-45-moonrise.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A randomized city landscape in the foreground gives way to a full moon and purple-red night sky.

Look for the North Star

ump-45-minotaurs-labyrinth.name: UMP-45 | Minotaur's Labyrinth
ump-45-minotaurs-labyrinth.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted with a hydrographic of an isometric labyrinth.

There's no escape from me

ump-45-facility-dark.name: UMP-45 | Facility Dark
ump-45-facility-dark.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A blue hydrographic pattern resembling a nuclear power plant has been applied.

Cut the lights

ump-45-full-stop.name: UMP-45 | Full Stop
ump-45-full-stop.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

xm1014-mockingbird.name: XM1014 | Mockingbird
xm1014-mockingbird.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A silver and gold design depicting birds in flight has been custom painted on the receiver.

Time spent with birds is never wasted
